request.input:
solo, full body, standing, front three-quarter view, looking at viewer, composed expression. Her left hand is raised before her chest in a gentle blessing gesture, fingers together; her right hand extends toward screen-left holding the ring handle of a small lantern with a glowing gold star inside. The long braid curves loosely behind the body, both eyes and both hands clearly visible.

Single complete character illustration for a game character selection screen, plain white background.

Vertical portrait composition, one centered figure, entire head, braid, skirt, boots and lantern inside the canvas. The figure fills about 88 percent of the canvas height, clean complete silhouette, no scenery.

Soft neutral daylight, warm gold lantern light on nearby white cloth. White, deep teal and muted gold palette, clear face and readable costume layers.
